issues.concern: The headword 解像 (kaizou) itself does not mean 'resolution (of an image)'. It is the root for 解像度 (kaizoudo), which means resolution. 解像 on its own is rarely used as a noun meaning resolution.
issues.suggestion: Change gloss to 'image analysis; image processing' or similar, reflecting its use as a verb stem or part of a compound, or remove the entry if it's not a standalone noun.

issues.concern: The gloss 'resolution; image resolution' for 解像 (kaizou) is incorrect. This meaning belongs to 解像度 (kaizoudo). 解像 itself is not typically used as a standalone noun with this meaning.
